item.tib: rig 'dzin yab sras rnams gsum thugs sgrubs las zhi ba'i bskangs chung bdud rtsi'i bum pa
item.coloph: ces pa zhi ba'i bskangs (skong) chung bdud rtsi'i bum pa zhes bya ba 'di sa phag zla tshes la rig 'dzin tshogs gral du phyin nas dbang lung brgyud bzhin phyis su dben gnas mad+hal ri khrod du shing sbrul zla tshes la br+d+wa' yig shar bzhin g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag gis tshes 10 yi nyi shar brda' yig dkar shogs (shog) la phab pa'o bkra shis so
